review_candidates.title: Full Stack Engineer
review_candidates.description: Full Stack Engineer III-V Build Secure, Scalable Applications That Power Mission-Critical Operations Georgia System Operations Corporation (GSOC) is seeking a Full Stack Engineer to add technical depth to the Enterprise Applications function and support the operational success of OPC, GTC, and GSOC through modern application development and engineering expertise. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, secure, and high-performing applications that support critical business operations. The position spans the full software development lifecycle from intuitive front-end user experiences to robust back-end services, integrations, databases, cloud deployments, and ongoing production support. The Full Stack Engineer builds and optimizes solutions using technologies such as Java, JavaScript frameworks including React and Angular, Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, cloud platforms, and DevOps practices. The role collaborates closely with business and technical teams to deliver integrated solutions that are reliable, secure, and aligned with organizational objectives. Candidates with deeper experience in application architecture, cloud-native technologies, DevOps, and enterprise application delivery may be considered for higher-level classifications (Engineer IV or V). This position is onsite and is not eligible for visa sponsorship What You'll Do As a Full Stack Engineer, you will design, develop, support, and improve applications that enable efficient, secure, and reliable business operations. Design, build, and optimize scalable applications using Java, React, Angular, Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, and related technologies. Develop modern, responsive, and intuitive front-end user interfaces. Build RESTful APIs, microservices, server-side logic, and integrations with internal and external systems. Develop and support cloud-native solutions across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments. Implement CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and DevOps practices using Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub, and GitLab. Develop and maintain integrations between critical business systems to improve data consistency and operational efficiency. Troubleshoot issues across the stack and implement corrective and preventive actions. Collaborate with business and technical teams to gather requirements and deliver integrated solutions. Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, and performance metrics. Research emerging technologies and recommend opportunities for continuous improvement. At advanced levels, this role may also: Lead application architecture and technology selection decisions. Provide technical leadership for enterprise application initiatives. Mentor engineers and establish development standards and practices. Influence long-term application strategy and modernization efforts. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. Equivalent combination of education, training, and directly related work experience may be considered. Engineer III: Ideally, 4+ years of full stack development experience including front-end and back-end technologies, integrations, and troubleshooting. Engineer IV: Ideally, 6+ years of full stack development and architecture experience. Engineer V: Ideally, 8+ years of experience architecting and managing enterprise-grade applications. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Customer-focused mindset with the ability to work independently and in team environments. Preferred Qualifications Full Stack Engineering & Architecture Proficiency with Java, JavaScript (React, Angular), Python, Node.js, and Spring Boot. Experience with APIs, microservices, enterprise integrations, and modern application architecture. Cloud, DevOps & Automation Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Git, GitHub, and GitLab. Data, Security & Enterprise Platforms Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, or similar databases. Knowledge of secure coding practices including SSL, OAuth, JWT, authentication, and application security. Understanding of ITIL processes and enterprise architecture practices. Certifications Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE Programmer. AWS Certified Developer - Associate. Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate. Google Cloud Certified - Professional Cloud Developer. Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD). Leveling Overview Engineer III - Experienced contributor who independently manages development assignments and supports critical business applications. Engineer IV - Senior engineer who leads projects, supports architecture decisions, and provides technical leadership. Engineer V - Expert-level engineer responsible for major enterprise initiatives, architecture leadership, and strategic technical direction. Advantages of Working at GSOC Working at GSOC means more than just a job--it's an opportunity to contribute to work that truly matters. Mission-Driven Impact Your work directly supports the applications and systems that help enable reliable operations across OPC, GTC, and GSOC. Modern Technology & Continuous Learning Work with modern frameworks, cloud technologies, DevOps tooling, and enterprise platforms while continuously expanding your technical capabilities. Strong Values and Professional Standards Work in an environment grounded in accountability, collaboration, integrity, and continuous improvement where security, reliability, service, and innovation are core priorities. Work Environment & Benefits GSOC offers a professional, collaborative work environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a commitment to creating a respectful and inclusive workplace. Why Join GSOC At GSOC, your work will help shape enterprise applications that enable efficient operations, better decision-making, and long-term business success across the Family of Companies. You will collaborate with skilled professionals in a mission-driven environment that encourages curiosity, innovation, technical excellence, and continuous improvement. Apply Today If you are ready to apply your full stack engineering expertise to build secure, scalable, and high-impact enterprise applications, we encourage you to apply. GSOC does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from staffing agencies, search firms, or third-party recruiters. Any unsolicited resumes submitted without a valid, executed agreement will become the property of GSOC, and no placement fee will be paid.
